names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 5 decembrie, «Sfântul Cuvios Nectarie», with the rank words left off; his life there gives Bitolia as his birthplace and Nicolae as his name in the world.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 5 Δεκεμβρίου, «Όσιος Νεκτάριος ο Αθωνίτης», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 5. децембар ст. ст., „Преподобни Нектарије Битољски.“ — with «Преподобни» left off, that being the `venerable` grade `types` keeps. «Битољски» is the city of Bitola and not a rank, it is what tells him from the other Nectarius folders, and §6 asks for the fullest form the calendar gives; it is also the one of the three calendars’ by-names that matches this folder’s display name, saint.gr calling him ο Αθωνίτης and doxologia.ro printing no by-name at all. `sr-foldpred.mjs` measured the folded string at 0 other holders.

birth.note: saint.gr: «Πατρίδα του Οσίου Νεκταρίου ήταν το Μοναστήρι της Μακεδονίας και γεννήθηκε το 1406 μ.Χ.», with the page's own head «(1406 - 1500)».

death.note: doxologia.ro: «şi-a dat fericitul său suflet, cu sfârşit paşnic, în mâinile lui Dumnezeu, în anii de la Hristos o mie cinci sute, în luna decembrie, ziua a cincea.» saint.gr says the same: «Ο Όσιος Νεκτάριος απεβίωσε ειρηνικά στις 5 Δεκεμβρίου του 1500 μ.Χ.»

saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 5ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Όσιος Νεκτάριος ο Αθωνίτης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 5 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps, and the entry is the same man although saint.gr calls him the Athonite rather than of Bitola: it gives his homeland as «το Μοναστήρι της Μακεδονίας», which is the Greek name of Bitola, and its date of death, 5 December 1500, is the folder's own. Its head gives «(1406 - 1500)», so the birth year is added here. The page also gives his baptismal name as Νικόλαος, his father's monastic name as Παχώμιος, and his elder as Φιλόθεος of the cell of the Archangels at Karyes, whom the same calendar keeps on the same day and who is drafted in this batch. No hymn is printed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 18.12.2025 (5. децембар ст. ст.) — „Преподобни Нектарије Битољски.“

attestations.note: The day’s third entry, quoted whole with its closing full stop; URL year 2025. `types` UNTOUCHED: «Преподобни» is the `venerable` held and `monk` the tonsure. `dates` UNTOUCHED and it is a THREE-BOOK AGREEMENT TO THE DAY: «преселио се у Царство Христово 5. децембра 1500. године» is the same 5 December 1500 doxologia.ro and saint.gr both state and the folder already carries as `attested`; the book gives no year of birth, so the 1406 off saint.gr’s head stands alone as it did. WHAT IT ADDS IS HIS HOUSEHOLD AND HIS CELL, and it is the only one of the three books to give either: he was of Bitola, and struggled first in the monastery of the Holy Unmercenaries near Bitola TOGETHER WITH HIS OWN FATHER, who had been tonsured Пахомије; then he crossed to Karyes and continued under the elders Филотеј and Дионисије in the cell of the Holy Archangel; and after human envy, the assaults of demons and a heavy illness were overcome, his wonderworking relics — whole, incorrupt and fragrant — repose in that same cell. NO `related` ROW ADDED: `philotheus-of-karyes` is the elder Филотеј and is already `related` here in both directions; the father Пахомије and the elder Дионисије are no folders this corpus holds, and naming a Dionysius or a Pachomius out of the many it does hold would be a guess. NO `locations`, and the folder has never held one. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.
